description: Convert blanks in each FILE to tabs, writing to standard output.

option.name: --all
tip: convert all blanks, instead of just initial blanks

option.name: --first-only
tip: convert only leading sequences of blanks (overrides -a)

option.name: --tabs
tip: have tabs N characters apart instead of 8 (enables -a)

use comma separated list of tab positions. The last specified position can be prefixed with '/' to specify a tab size to use after the last explicitly specified tab stop. Also a prefix of '+' can be used to align remaining tab stops relative to the last specified tab stop instead of the first column
